resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Tuples[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

[b]Tuples [/b]are very similar to lists, except that they are immutable (they cannot be changed). 
Also, they are created using [b]parentheses[/b], rather than square brackets.

[s0l0!-header][b]Example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="py" ]words = [b]([/b]"spam", "eggs", "sausages"[b])[/b][/code]
You can access the values in the tuple with their index, just as you did with lists:[code format="py" codeId="365"]print(words[0])[/code]
Trying to reassign a value in a tuple causes an error. [code format="py" codeId="366"]words[1] = "cheese"[/code]
[note]Like lists and dictionaries, tuples can be nested within each other.[/note]

resolved.title: 搜索联系人
resolved.problem_statement_md:
给定一个联系人列表，每个联系人用一个**元组**表示，其中有联系人的姓名**name**和年龄**age**。

编写该程序，输入一个字符串，在联系人列表中搜索该人名，并以示例格式输出该联系人的年龄。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Tuples[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are given a list of contacts, where each contact is represented by a [b]tuple[/b], with the [b]name[/b] and [b]age[/b] of the contact.
Complete the program to get a string as input, search for the name in the list of contacts and output the age of the contact in the format presented below:

[b]Sample Input[/b]
John

[b]Sample Output [/b]
John is 31 

[note]If the contact is not found, the program should output "[b]Not Found[/b]".[/note]
resolved.hint_md: 如果没有找到联系人，程序应输出 "**Not Found**"。

code_templates.solution_code:
contacts = [
    ('James', 42),
    ('Amy', 24),
    ('John', 31),
    ('Amanda', 63),
    ('Bob', 18)
]

name = input()

notFound = True
for x in contacts:
    if x[0]==name:
        print(f"{name} is {x[1]}")
        notFound = False
        break
if notFound:
    print("Not Found")
